inputs.checklistItemText: Buildings and permanent structures do not maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors
inputs.question: Are there any overhead utility lines (O.H.U.L.) shown on the existing conditions survey? If so, are they labeled as electric lines and what is their location relative to the proposed buildings?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a presence and identification check (do O.H.U.L. exist, are they labeled as electric, where are they located) rather than measuring the actual clearance distance between buildings and conductors. This is progressive verification—sheet discovery and feature identification before the clearance measurement itself.
